mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_sso_state ( state_hash, provider, return_path, redirect_uri, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{stateHash}, 'FEISHU', #{returnPath}, #{redirectUri}, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND) )
mapper.select: SELECT return_path, redirect_uri FROM t_auth_sso_state WHERE state_hash = #{stateHash} AND provider = 'FEISHU' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > NOW(3)
